maddeler.e:
يستحثوا (form X)
# يَسْتَحِثُّوا (yastaḥiṯṯū) /jas.ta.ħiθ.θuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# يُسْتَحَثُّوا (yustaḥaṯṯū) /jus.ta.ħaθ.θuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
